displayIdentity.body: One Spirit distributes many manifestations. Now about spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant. But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
displayIdentity.title: One Spirit distributes many manifestations
